archivedClosureDrift.reason: The archived R3-L0C plans bind an EXECUTION_CLOSURE digest over the runtime manifest of dist/src modules plus a source-import graph. V0 adds three src/ modules, so that digest necessarily moves and the archived plan's recorded closure cannot match a changed source tree.
archivedClosureDrift.provenPreExisting: In the T0 stage an isolated worktree at the baseline commit reproduced the identical 15 failures with zero trajectory code present; V0 changes no archived-plan input other than by adding product source, and the failing SET is byte-identical to the T0 baseline.
